searches.reason: Investigate whether easy training negatives conceal ranking weaknesses, especially in Electronics, where 10.71% of sampled negatives beat positives. Seek practical objectives for one HSTU model per category; compare using fixed macro validation HR@10, since large training margins do not establish generalization.

searches.reason: Explore whether a jointly trained temporal mechanism can distinguish recent intent from persistent interests and completed purchases. Use observed histories and timestamps while preserving the causal HSTU backbone and final nonpadding readout.

searches.reason: Find ways to learn fine-grained compatibility and content distinctions from available titles and descriptions. Prioritize lightweight text encoders trained from scratch and integrated into a single HSTU network, without external pretrained weights, unavailable attributes, or separately fitted scoring models.
